positiveActivities.validation_calibration: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 Thursday 2018-02-15 Slowloris (new independent public capture; must pass join and quality review)

benignPolicy: publisher BENIGN in same observed TCP/80 scope and authorized endpoint-bound controlled tasks only; never reinterpret unlabelled traffic or rewrite ports

controlledTasks.authorization: pending explicit win-dev loopback TCP/80 capture scope
controlledTasks.grouping: one task session wholly assigned to one role; distinct sessions and fresh extractor boot; minimum 150s separation

publicBenignGrouping: capture/server/client activity groups; no per-row random splits; server-view capture coverage limitations reported separately
parentPolicy: complete parent and all continuation/snapshot rows remain in one role; ambiguous or crossing parent excluded
duplicatePolicy: existing frozen final-feature signature; all parents in a cross-role exact/near-duplicate group excluded
prefixPolicy: adjudicate all 475 original structural candidates against publisher exclusions and actual causal observations; no unconditional promotion; incomplete independent prefix selection/calibration blocks prefix research qualification

acquisitionBudget.strategy: read official ZIP directory, acquire only complete relevant capture members and corrected day labels; verify object identity, member CRC32, byte counts and SHA256; do not present partial archive as full archive

qualification: counted data must satisfy source, label, scope, whole-activity isolation and provenance checks; adequacy is reported by role and task; no release or live-network qualification

finalTest.exclude: all already exposed CIC2017 and new 2018 development/calibration material and their mirrors
